findings.title: Fractional timestamps bypass the stated same-second ambiguity policy
findings.detail: Distinct content in one wall-clock second is ordered by microseconds although comments say sub-second publisher ordering is outside schema v1.
findings.minimal_fix: Compare second-granularity publication time for ambiguity, or explicitly define and test a supported trustworthy sub-second ordering contract.

findings.title: Developer grant hook revives explicit application denials/questions
findings.detail: Application regex matches a positive substring inside not-accepting or applicant-question text; the grant hook runs outside existing available_clauses filtering.
findings.minimal_fix: Add narrowly tested negated acceptance/not-open and applicant-intent guards to the grant helper; keep genuine grant announcements and keyword opt-in controls.

findings.title: All-query stripping collapses distinct functional resource identities
findings.synthetic_case: Same /view path with different program selectors and different titles
findings.detail: This is more than removing tracking labels; a distinct public resource may disappear from the blind denominator. Source producer may already have discarded such query identity, which this selector cannot reconstruct.
findings.minimal_fix: Document this canonical-identity limitation or preserve approved functional identity separately; do not describe it as exact original-URL deduplication.

limits: Only current safe source and synthetic fixtures. No old Git/cache, real private data or new public samples read.
No fixture amount text or historical sensitive literals printed or persisted in review output.
No worktree edits, production, network, full regression or accuracy claim.
Withdrawal/candidate keys remain manual-review signals, never live availability or closure proof.
